verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents APIs that expose accounting-relevant data. The Card Expenses API lets you retrieve approved expenses and mark them as synced into an ERP or accounting system, and the Bills API lets you create and manage vendor invoices. However, no dedicated accounting API is evidenced, so the story is only partly covered. Missing for 10: a dedicated accounting API for viewing and managing accounting data such as chart of accounts, GL codes, tracking categories or journal entries; broader accounting-data management beyond expense and bill sync; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage accounting data through a dedicated API

citations.quote: The Card Expenses API lets you retrieve approved card expenses from Airwallex and mark them as synced after ingesting them into your ERP or accounting system.
The Bills API lets you create and manage invoices received from vendors for goods or services.
